Creative Analytics Digest (last 3 months). Reviewed 134 ads.

What won: The top-performing copy "experience every note with clarity. Get boAt Signature Sound & AI ENx™ with WIND" outperformed the account average by 567%. Other strong copy themes like "built for non-stop listening" and "unique earphones for a unique you" beat averages by over 500%. Ads with a curiosity hook also showed a 366% higher CTR than average.

What lost: Ads set in indoor home environments performed poorly, delivering just 51% of the account average ROAS and a CTR 47% below average. Testimonial modes and social proof hooks underperformed significantly, with performance indexes around 49% of average. Fast-paced ads and UGC formats also lagged behind, showing less than 50% of average ROAS.

The bigger picture: Top ads frequently combined black color with an elegant mood, achieving a 524% performance boost over average. Blue paired with a trendy mood or benefit-led hooks also drove strong results. Future creative briefs should focus on elegant black visuals and trendy blue themes with clear benefit-led messaging to maximize impact.

output.digest_text:
Creative Analytics Digest (last 3 months). Reviewed 134 ads.

What won: The top-performing copy "experience every note with clarity. Get boAt Signature Sound & AI ENx™ with WIND" outperformed the account average by 567%. Other strong copy themes like "built for non-stop listening" and "unique earphones for a unique you" beat averages by over 500%. Ads with a curiosity hook also showed a 366% higher CTR than average.

What lost: Ads set in indoor home environments performed poorly, delivering just 51% of the account average ROAS and a CTR 47% below average. Testimonial modes and social proof hooks underperformed significantly, with performance indexes around 49% of average. Fast-paced ads and UGC formats also lagged behind, showing less than 50% of average ROAS.

The bigger picture: Top ads frequently combined black color with an elegant mood, achieving a 524% performance boost over average. Blue paired with a trendy mood or benefit-led hooks also drove strong results. Future creative briefs should focus on elegant black visuals and trendy blue themes with clear benefit-led messaging to maximize impact.

Ads to scale: 6916666028813, 6886994567613, 6690919674213, 6777963106013, 52638960494017 — All rank in the top 50% by performance index, showing strong ROAS and CTR, making them prime candidates for increased budget.

Ads to watch: 52645901141417, 52655168506817, 52645898305417, 52645901139417, 52645901141617 — Middle-tier performers (20th–50th percentile); monitor closely before scaling or pausing.

Ads to pause: 52655737183417, 52655737183617, 52655737183817, 52640573033417, 52641030944217 — Bottom 20% by performance index; consider pausing or reducing spend to optimize budget.
